day_line: An ocean on a Rat day. Deep and quick: good for clever plans and easy chats, easy to say too much.

lines.Yang Wood: A clear thought arrives on the bus today. Save it as a voice note before it drifts.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone lightens your Friday. Let them take one task; lunch is on you.
lines.Yang Fire: Friday runs hot for you. Finish the must-do, then leave the laptop at work.
lines.Yin Fire: People respect your calm today. Lead the meeting; keep it to thirty minutes.
lines.Yang Earth: A good deal finds you today. Grab it, but check the return policy.
lines.Yin Earth: Patient money wins today. Move a little into savings before the weekend.
lines.Yang Metal: Friday fun is yours today. Pick the karaoke song you secretly love.
lines.Yin Metal: Your words are clever today. Write the toast, the card or the caption now.
lines.Yang Water: Your crowd flows together today. Say yes to the last-minute dinner.
lines.Yin Water: Someone talks faster today. Let them; your one good line lands later.
